4 Gummies | 50MG Each | Distillate

Our Red Razz Distillate Gummies are built for everyday relief with a punch of juicy raspberry flavor. Each gummy is infused with 50MG of cannabis distillate, delivering a consistent and accessible experience that fits seamlessly into your rhythm.

With a fruit-forward profile and dependable texture, this gummy is a reliable companion for relaxed, anytime vibes.

Whether you're easing into your evening or keeping it simple—this gummy is always within reach.
